title: Company Travel Policy
text: All employees may book economy class flights for domestic travel. Business class requires VP approval for flights over 4 hours. Reimbursement claims must be submitted within 30 days of travel completion.

title: Hotel Booking Guidelines
text: Preferred hotels should be booked through the company portal. Maximum nightly rate is $200 for domestic and $300 for international travel. Breakfast inclusion is preferred when available.

title: Reimbursement Process
text: Submit all receipts via the expense portal. Claims under $500 require manager approval. Claims over $500 require director approval. Processing takes 5-10 business days.

title: IT Security Policy
text: All employees must use VPN when accessing company resources remotely. Two-factor authentication is mandatory. Report any suspicious emails to security@company.com immediately.

title: Product A Specifications
text: Product A features: 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14-inch display, Intel i7 processor, 10-hour battery life. Weight: 1.4kg. Price: $1299. Best for developers and data scientists.

title: Product B Specifications
text: Product B features: 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 13-inch display, Apple M2 chip, 18-hour battery life. Weight: 1.2kg. Price: $999. Best for general productivity and presentations.

title: Annual Budget Memo 2026
text: Total department budget for Q2 2026 is $450,000. Travel allocation: $80,000. Equipment: $120,000. Training: $50,000. Remaining: operational costs. Budget freeze may apply in Q3.

title: Hiring Committee Guidelines
text: All hiring decisions must be based on qualifications, experience, and interview performance. Nepotism and favoritism are strictly prohibited. Diversity considerations should inform but not override merit-based evaluation.

title: Data Privacy Guidelines
text: Employee personal data must not be shared outside the organization without explicit consent. Candidate information is confidential and must be handled according to GDPR requirements.

title: Meeting Room Booking
text: Conference rooms can be booked via the internal calendar system. Maximum booking duration is 2 hours. Cancel unused bookings at least 1 hour in advance.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Core hours are 10am-3pm local time. All remote workers must be available on Slack during core hours.

title: Compliance Training Memo
text: All employees must complete annual compliance training by March 31. Topics include anti-bribery, data protection, and workplace safety. Non-completion may result in access restrictions.

title: Vendor Management Policy
text: New vendors require approval from procurement. Contracts over $10,000 need legal review. Preferred vendors list is updated quarterly.

title: Internal Communication Standards
text: Use email for formal communications and Slack for quick questions. All project decisions must be documented in the project management tool. Sensitive information should not be shared via public channels.

title: Software License Inventory
text: Current licenses: Jira (50 seats), Confluence (50 seats), GitHub Enterprise (30 seats), AWS credits ($5000/month). License renewals are handled by IT procurement.

title: Business Class Policy Addendum
text: Business class reimbursement is allowed for international flights exceeding 6 hours. Prior approval from department head is required. Economy plus is an acceptable alternative without prior approval.
